title: Moonlit Meadow
body: This custom camper van is designed for ultimate comfort and off-grid living, featuring everything you need to hit the road in style. Inside, you'll find a full-size memory foam bed for restful nights and an Acacia butcher block countertop, adding a touch of elegance to the fully equipped kitchen. The kitchen includes a portable single-burner induction cooktop, a top-mount stainless steel sink with a modern faucet, and a 3-cubic-foot refrigerator with a freezer, making meal prep on the go easy and convenient. The 30-gallon freshwater tank, 23-gallon winterized grey water tank, and water purification unit ensure you’ll have clean water wherever your travels take you.

The van’s interior is thoughtfully designed for maximum storage and usability, including two overhead cabinets, under-counter cabinets, and a spacious under-bed garage area. Enjoy an indoor shower with an electric hot water heater, complemented by a cassette-style toilet with a 5-gallon capacity for practical functionality. The van’s cozy atmosphere is enhanced with painted shiplap siding, a natural wood-stained ceiling, and dimmable recessed LED ceiling lights. For energy efficiency, the 300W solar system with lithium batteries, a 2500W pure sine wave inverter, and shore power electrical plugin keep everything running smoothly. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the Fresair evaporative cooler, Maxxair ceiling vent fan, and the convenient outdoor shower for refreshing experiences after off-road adventures.
This van's modern design, from vinyl wood-style flooring to swivel passenger and driver seats, provides both comfort and style on every journey.
